_meta.purpose: Competing-hypothesis structure for suspect classification (ACH spirit: equal display + refutation focus; log-odds mechanics). Likelihoods P(E|H) are HAND-SET engineering judgements documented per indicator — they make the ranking transparent, they are NOT calibrated probabilities. Do not display percentages unless the caller supplies a calibration and sets allow_percentages=true.

hypotheses.label: KINGPIN_ORGANIZER
hypotheses.description: Operates the scheme; originates instructions; funds move through others' accounts.

hypotheses.label: LAYER1_MULE
hypotheses.description: Rented/sold account; fast pass-through of victim funds to downstream layers.

hypotheses.label: COMPROMISED_VICTIM
hypotheses.description: Genuine account owner whose credentials/account were misused.

indicators.name: pass_through_speed
indicators.note: Pass-through within minutes is the classic mule signature.

indicators.name: account_age
indicators.note: Mule accounts are typically opened shortly before use.

indicators.name: victim_contact
indicators.note: Multiple victims calling the same number indicates an operator, not a mule.
